key_insight: LOKI discovers row-level join paths between disjoint tables by using text as evidence, turning implicit semantic links into explicit, typed integrations.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical data-lake integration workflow for heterogeneous datasets when schemas or direct keys are missing, with interpretable provenance for each joined row.
method: Horizontal bidirectional cross-attention links table rows and sentences in a shared latent space.
A global table-text contrastive objective learns fine-grained row-sentence associations without local labels.
Discovered associations are grouped into relation-consistent join paths and materialized as typed tables with sentence-level provenance.
evidence_signal: On real-world benchmarks, LOKI outperformed prior multi-modal discovery methods and achieved 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40× cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality textual evidence and may be sensitive to noisy or incomplete text, which can limit row-level discovery accuracy.
paper_title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
